facts.fact: NimbaPay, the national instant payment system, is an initiative of the BCRG and its partners, put into service on 22 July 2026 with the Governor presiding, per Mediaguinee.

GIN.note: User protection is mentioned only as an aim; no rules or body stated.
Cross-border payments only named as a next step.
State payments only named as a next step.
Account access of close to 36% in 2024 is given with no survey named.

facts.fact: With NimbaPay, launched 22 July 2026, anyone in Guinea can send or receive money instantly from one bank, e-money institution or microfinance institution to another, per Governor Karamo Kaba.
Governor Kaba says account access rose from 4% in 2011 to close to 36% in 2024 notably through electronic money, so e-money is in service.

GIN.note: Nothing on tax or fee collection.
